# Embedded Emissions: Ribbed Reinforcing Bar from Türkiye

**Embedded emissions: 577.50 tCO2e**

| Input | Value | Status |
|---|---|---|
| CN code | 7214 20 00 (bars and rods, of iron or non-alloy steel, with indentations…) | In table |
| Country of production | Türkiye | Listed for this CN code |
| Quantity | 250 t | Provided |
| Default SEE (7214 20 00, Türkiye) | 2.31 tCO2e/t | Selected from table |

**Calculation**

Embedded emissions = SEE × quantity
= 2.31 tCO2e/t × 250 t
= **577.50 tCO2e**

The China (3.169) and India (4.27) values for this CN code do not apply. Only the Türkiye value was used.
